heading: Recording rules
savedDescription: Saved configuration is not activation or SQL delivery.
effectiveDescription: Immutable rules at the server observation; retained history does not prove active intake or SQL success.
groupScope: Complete group scope; not exclusive to the viewed device
requestedNotEffective: The latest requested revision is not the revision effective at this server observation.
details: View complete rules and delivery evidence
detailsTitle: Rules and evidence for this scope
detailsDescription: Read-only configuration references and verified evidence. Inspecting this view changes nothing.
detailsUnavailable: Matching details are unavailable. Refresh the evidence or inspect the existing preparation controls.
unsavedDescription: These are the current editor choices, not saved or effective rules. No recording group has been invented.
noScope: Choose a saved device to inspect its recording rules.
effectiveCounterUnavailable: Historical counter bindings, policy and epochs are unavailable in this evidence. Saved values are not effective proof.
tablePending: Table determined when configuration is saved
savedReferences: Saved schema references are not a current schema verification.
deliveryDescription: Group-level, revision-bound delivery evidence. Accepted, queued, SQL committed, readback and cleanup are separate stages.

reasons.missing: Evidence is missing. Refresh to check again.
reasons.error: Evidence could not be read. Retry when connected.
reasons.unknown: Evidence is unknown. Refresh to check again.
reasons.scope_mismatch: The evidence does not match this scope.
reasons.revision_mismatch: The revision changed. Refresh the evidence.
reasons.operation_unresolved: An operation remains unresolved. Inspect the existing operation controls.
reasons.stale: The evidence is stale. Refresh to check again.
reasons.invalid_evidence: The evidence could not be verified.

next.heading: Next step

reasons.counter_confirmation: Confirm the selected counter definition before proceeding.
reasons.save_required: Save these choices before preparing their table.
reasons.offline: Reconnect for network commands. Local inspection remains available.
reasons.operation_recovery: Resolve the retained original operation before creating another.
reasons.evidence_error: Current preparation evidence could not be read.
reasons.evidence_unavailable: Current owner evidence is unavailable; do not start a new operation.
reasons.schema_review: Review the table changes before confirming them.
reasons.schema_confirmation: Only confirmation below applies the reviewed table changes.
reasons.schema_conflict: Inspect and repair the table preparation blocker.
reasons.lifecycle_unavailable: Current saved-setting action availability is unavailable.
reasons.lifecycle_blocked: The server currently blocks changes to this saved setting.
reasons.start_review: Review the exact selected sources, rules and destination before starting.
reasons.scope_unavailable: This selection cannot be matched to current evidence.

next.fixControls: Review the current source, interval, destination or capability controls. No new operation is permitted until the blocker is resolved.
next.startDescription: Only the displayed device and recording groups will be submitted through the existing start operation.
next.deliverySeparate: Starting, accepting rows, SQL commit, readback and cleanup are separate outcomes. This confirmation is not SQL success.
next.preparedOnly: Preparation only: starting is not available in this view.

management.workspaceStatus: This overview covers saved recordings across the workspace; it does not start or activate them. Managed profiles still use their own reviewed device scope. Opening a card changes no settings.
management.openDetails: View saved settings and delivery evidence
management.actionsUnavailable: Management actions are unavailable while the saved scope is refreshing or another operation is active. You can still view saved settings and delivery evidence.

completion.heading: Recording start result
completion.noneActivated: No device activation has been confirmed.
completion.deliverySeparate: Activation is not proof of SQL commit, readback or cleanup. Check the separate delivery evidence.
